observations.observed: Both staging paths remain provisional_new_catalog_staging_only. The new wrapper calls prepareCatalogSourceReport and requireClosedCatalogSourceReport before low-level staging; this five-file inspection establishes call ordering, not closure semantics of those callees. Low-level staging does not independently run that source preflight. Complete support, report, resource and finalizer admission remain required.
Native new-catalog collector checks original Record and Field storage identities and creation revision against original declaration matcher.
Absent original binding selects json property homes under ADR-002; explicit binding interpretation is required separately.
CONTRACT-007 distinguishes business keys from object IDs and requires original object/edge identity, property catalog allocation, JSON member and row-home joins.

Staging resolves archived associationRecord to its same-document/revision property-owner Record; the selected owner Key is checked only when associationRecord.key is explicit. Native inventory independently re-resolves the owner and checks assoc_type_id, including NULL for absent association ownership. This does not establish a native edge business Key or public admission.
